description_en: This operation is no longer maintained. New enterprises should use the Create Enterprise Department, Modify Enterprise Department Information, and Delete Enterprise Department operations to maintain department information. Calls this operation to create, update, or delete department information for a specified enterprise in Alibaba Business Travel
description_zh: 本接口已不再维护，新接入企业请使用创建企业部门、修改企业部门信息、删除企业部门三个接口进行部门信息的维护。通过调用本接口可以实现新增、维护、删除阿里商旅指定企业下的部门信息
kebab_example: aliyun btripopen department-save --depart-list depart_id=1 depart_pid=1 third_depart_id=third_dept_0001 manager_ids=user_0001_user_0002_user_0003 depart_name=产品研发部 third_depart_pid=third_dept_001 status=0 --x-acs-btrip-so-corp-token feth0000ls --api-version 2022-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DepartmentSave

fields.help_en: The (legacy) department ID. Either this parameter or `third_depart_id` must be specified
fields.help_zh: （旧）部门 ID，需与 `third_depart_id` 二选一作为必填参数传入
fields.name: depart_id

fields.help_en: The (legacy) parent department ID of the current department. Either this parameter or `third_depart_pid` must be specified
fields.help_zh: （旧）当前部门的父部门 ID，需与 `third_depart_pid` 二选一作为必填参数传入
fields.name: depart_pid

fields.help_en: The department manager ID. If multiple managers exist, separate their IDs with a pipe character (|)
fields.help_zh: 部门主管 ID，当存在多个部门主管时，主管 ID 间使用 “|” 分隔
fields.name: manager_ids

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the department
fields.name: status

fields.help_en: The (new) department ID. Either this parameter or `depart_id` must be specified
fields.help_zh: （新）部门 ID，需与 `depart_id` 二选一作为必填参数传入
fields.name: third_depart_id

fields.help_en: The (new) parent department ID of the current department. Either this parameter or `depart_pid` must be specified
fields.help_zh: （新）当前部门的父部门 ID，需与 `depart_pid` 二选一作为必填参数传入
fields.name: third_depart_pid

是 HTTP 调用方式的 header 必填参数之一，获取方式请参见：企业访问凭证 (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=3769985)。
可以在请求地址中使用 `corp_token=value` 替代
